name: BOD INCUBATOR
desc: Premium BOD Incubator engineered to maintain a highly stable and precise temperature environment (typically 20°C) for microorganism growth and biological oxygen demand testing. Built with a high-density PUF-insulated double-wall structure and a microprocessor-based PID digital controller.
features: High precision PID temperature control with PT-100 Sensor
Motorized forced draft fan for uniform air circulation
Microprocessor based dual digital LED/LCD display

specifications.Exterior Body Material: Heavy-Duty Mild Steel (M.S.) with Corrosion-Resistant Powder Coating
specifications.Insulation: Thick Polyurethane Foam (PUF) insulation between double walls
specifications.Display Type: Microprocessor Based Dual Digital LED/LCD Display
specifications.Air Circulation: Motorized Forced Draft Fan for Uniformity
specifications.Controller: PID Temperature Controller with PT-100 Sensor
